title: Leibniz’s Monadology as Foundation for the Artificial Age Score: A Formal Architecture for AI Memory Evaluation
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion. Its key finding is that twenty core propositions from Leibniz's Monadology can be successfully transformed into a modular, measurable, and mathematically rigorous architecture (the Artificial Age Score) for evaluating AI memory systems. This framework operationalizes philosophical concepts like monads, appetition, and harmony as information-theoretic principles for building and assessing AI memory.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It develops a formal framework (Artificial Age Score) for evaluating AI memory systems, based on the metaphysical and structural principles of Leibniz's Monadology.
